policy: Only approval_status=approved, licence_status=verified, and allowed_uses containing training may enter the pipeline.

corpora.name: UniversalCEFR corpus index
corpora.reason: Useful discovery index, but every subcorpus has separate terms and must be approved independently.

corpora.name: MERLIN German learner corpus
corpora.reason: Freely downloadable without registration from the CLARIN Eurac repository; licence verified as CC-BY-SA-4.0. Approved 2026-08-30 for the German transformer run. Attribution/share-alike obligation: any redistribution of derived text or model outputs trained on this corpus must credit the MERLIN project (https://www.merlin-platform.eu/) and remain under a compatible share-alike licence.

corpora.name: CEFR Levelled English Texts
corpora.reason: Confirmed 2026-08-30: the creator's own writeup states texts are pulled from The British Council, ESLFast, and the cnn-dailymail dataset. The Kaggle uploader does not hold rights to those underlying sources, so the dataset licence tag does not clear redistribution or training use. Remains blocked; use ace-cefr as the licensed substitute for English.

corpora.name: Ace-CEFR conversational text difficulty dataset
corpora.reason: Purpose-built human-expert-labelled CEFR difficulty dataset (890 conversational passages, 445 train / 445 test) authored by Kogan, Schumacher, Nguyen, Suzuki, Smith, Bellows, and Bernstein at Google Research, released CC0-1.0 as an arXiv ancillary file (arXiv:2506.14046). Approved 2026-08-30 as the licensed substitute for the blocked Kaggle English corpus. Retrieved via the GliteTech/research-ace-cefr mirror, which packages the same CC0 file under its own Apache-2.0 code licence (data licence governs, not the wrapper repo's code licence).

corpora.name: TOEFL-CEFR vocabulary
corpora.reason: Vocabulary support data is not a learner-writing classification corpus; metadata and terms need verification.

corpora.name: Kaggle CELP competition reference
corpora.reason: The exact task, data files, labels, and licence have not been verified as a CEFR learner-text corpus.

corpora.name: CEFR-J English Profile
corpora.reason: Valuable controlled vocabulary/grammar reference for RAG and validation, not the primary learner-text classifier corpus.

corpora.name: DAFlex German receptive lexicon
corpora.reason: Useful German lexical feature source, but redistribution/download terms must be confirmed before ingestion.

corpora.name: Repository-generated test fixture
corpora.reason: May test pipeline behavior only; its metrics are excluded from the research dashboard.
